releases.name: Sun Ultimate War
releases.summary: If you're a Tower Defense Game fan, you CANNOT miss Sun Ultimate War! Unleash ultimate plants: Watermelon Cannon, Abyss Demon, Doom Knight Mushroom. Melt dark army with Supreme Nuke & Abyss Death Ray. Defend camp. Let Milky Way burn! Let sea of stars boil! Wishlist now and command your solar legion

releases.name: Soma Cube
releases.summary: Soma Cube is a focused 3D puzzle game with seven pieces and 12 shapes to solve. Rotate, move, and combine the pieces to build each model. Test your spatial reasoning, and solve every shape at your own pace.

releases.name: Kubo
releases.summary: A sci-fi 3D puzzle game where you place and rotate route cards across the faces of a rotatable cube to connect stars, fill every Kube, and restore a fractured cosmic network level by level.

releases.name: Sealed
releases.summary: A black-site facility has lost containment. The abominations inside are awake and hunting, and you're the last one out. Eliminate every hostile, break the lockdown, and reach extraction. Deal with them, or get dealt with.

releases.name: Get Off My Garden
releases.summary: This is a small project I made over 3 months alone. It is a Movement FPS RogueLike with stress on choosing your weapons and upgrades you want to focus on. Difficulty scales with time and most runs will be finished in around 20 minutes if you are speed-running it. Have Fun!

releases.name: Tahoe Joe
releases.summary: Climb your way through a series of increasingly dangerous levels in this fast-paced 2D platformer inspired by classic arcade challenge. Tahoe Joe hurls barrels directly at you, tracking your every move. You’ll need quick reactions, precise movement, and perfect timing to survive.

releases.name: No Results Found
releases.summary: One computer. One room. And records that were never erased. Search. Can you uncover the whole truth?

releases.name: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Catastrophe! An evil wizard has cast a tornado spell on your shop, and now all your products are on the floor. Maybe you'll ask some friends for help to tidy up?

releases.name: Mike the Hooper
releases.summary: Mike the Hooper is a 2D basketball puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and help Mike get home. Find your way through each level, make tricky shots, and overcome platforming challenges along the way.

releases.name: Smile Town
releases.summary: Pay off your debts by working part-time in the nightlife district of Smile Town! Buy items from your friend Apple Ginger's shop to get an advantage at your part-time job.

releases.name: The Brothers Karamazov
releases.summary: Весь роман Достоевского, слово в слово - живописное, атмосферное чтение на русском и английском. Ваш выбор не меняет ход событий; он лишь проявляет, к кому из братьев вы ближе на компасе: вера, разум, сердце или сомнение.

releases.name: Emberfall Idle
releases.summary: Build a party of adventurers, master gathering and crafting professions, and explore a fantasy world that continues progressing while you're away. Battle monsters, earn powerful loot, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger through long-term idle RPG progression.

releases.name: Fleetfall - Galaxy Domination
releases.summary: Fast real-time space conquest for 1-4 players. Capture planets, launch missile salvos, and outmaneuver friends in 10-minute Deathmatch blitzes — or scheme through 30 minutes of diplomacy, trade and betrayal in Hegemony mode. Cross-play with mobile; bots fill empty seats so a match always starts.

releases.name: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

releases.name: Totally Normal Meat Co.
releases.summary: Raise adorable monsters and process them into profit in this dark-humored idle management sim. Designed as a desktop companion, it runs at the bottom of your screen while you work. Optimize your production line, unlock rare species, and automate your way to a morally questionable empire.

releases.name: Asteroid Station
releases.summary: Asteroid Station is about mining asteroids, but that's not all! Battle hostile machines, defeat powerful bosses, and upgrade your ship as you push deeper into dangerous sectors in this top-down space mining and combat game.

releases.name: SURA: Shattered Star
releases.summary: is a space-themed sword-fighting action platformer. Play as Sura, a retired mercenary-turned-warrior grieving the loss of his family, and cut down everything that stands in your way.

releases.name: Grey Prince
releases.summary: Grey Prince offers brutal combats which every fight is a fight to death. Explore, get lost, solve puzzles, nagivate around forbidden dungeons to escape this unjust nightmare. Unravel the story of a forgotten prisoner for his fight for survival and escape.

releases.name: Bumper Core
releases.summary: Bumper Core is a fast-paced arcade physics game where you defend your core by striking incoming shapes into goals. Hit harder for bigger scores, chain combos to multiply them, and survive the escalating storm then build your own levels and share them.

releases.name: Zankoi's Chronicles
releases.summary: A deck building game fused with 2D fighting action. Fight in real time, shatter enemy's Poise to stop time, then unleash guaranteed card combos. No meta upgrades — only skill, builds, and mastery define each run.

releases.name: sobosuba
releases.summary: Shoot, squish, merge, amass! sobosuba is a satisfying physics game where you shoot and combine squishy blobs together, creating ever bigger blobs for the high score.
